title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
abstract: arXiv:2608.29058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. translated_title: RouteSparse：面向预算约束长上下文预填充的输入条件模式路由
translated_abstract: 动态稀疏注意力可以在不改变模型权重的情况下降低长上下文预填充的二次方计算开销。MInference 在离线阶段为每个注意力头分配一种固定模式，并为每个提示词估计该模式的稀疏索引。这种设计虽然高效，但它假设每个注意力头偏好的模式和稀疏预算在所有输入上都保持适用。我们提出了 RouteSparse，它在一个小型 GPU 高效稀疏模式库中为每个注意力头和提示片段进行动态路由。一个低成本的探测器估计各模式的效用与不确定性；随后由一个延迟感知的路由器选择模式和预算，而对不确定的情况则回退到更密集的掩码。我们将路由问题形式化为约束风险最小化，从被省略的概率质量中推导出注意力输出的误差证书，并在长上下文检索、问答、摘要和语言建模任务上对该方法进行了评估。在 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct 上使用 128K token 提示词的实验中，RouteSparse……
tldr: RouteSparse 通过在小型 GPU 高效稀疏模式库中为每个注意力头和提示片段进行输入条件化动态路由，结合低成本效用探测、延迟感知路由决策和注意力输出误差证书，克服了 MInference 等固定模式方法假设单一模式对所有输入都适用的局限，在长上下文预填充中实现效率与精度的更好平衡。
en_tdlr: RouteSparse dynamically routes each attention head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns, using a low-cost utility probe, a latency-aware router, and attention-output error certificates to overcome the fixed-pattern assumption of methods like MInference, achieving a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off for budgeted long-context prefilling.
